story:
Maya's Red Ball

Maya plays. Maya has a red ball. The red ball is bouncy! Maya loves her red ball. *Boing!* The red ball rolls. Oh no! The red ball rolls under the big blue couch. Maya sees it. "Ball!" says Maya.

Mama comes. Mama sees the red ball. Mama looks sad. "Oh no," Mama says. "Big couch!" Mama points. "Can Maya help?" Mama asks. Maya nods. Maya gets down low. Maya's hand is small. Mama says, "Let's work together." Mama helps Maya. Mama holds Maya's feet. Maya reaches, reaches. It is hard.

"Got it!" says Maya. Maya pulls the red ball out! *Pop!* The red ball is safe. "Yay, Maya!" Mama claps. Mama gives Maya a big hug. "You are so helpful," Mama says. Maya feels proud. Mama and Maya play with the red ball together. What a caring family!
